args.comment: Compromised credential: service account key CKEY-12D47068CA043025 (project ledger-prod) was used from 198.19.169.245, an anonymizing exit with a malicious reputation, to download 874 GB tagged pricing model; its only expected callers are CI-DEN-33 and BAS-DEN-57. 198.19.169.245 blocked, immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-12D47068CA043025 requested from the cloud platform team, audit log preserved, escalated to incident response and privacy; BAS-DEN-57 and CI-DEN-33 left online, case left open.

eval_cases.prompt: Urgent alert CASE-32478: service account key CKEY-12D47068CA043025 for cloud project ledger-prod authenticated from external address 198.19.169.245 and downloaded 874 GB of objects tagged pricing model since 2026-09-24T00:57:00Z. The key was issued on bastion BAS-DEN-57 (10.19.0.105) by dmitri.mehta and is normally used only by deploy runner CI-DEN-33 (10.19.0.122). [CMDB Asset Context: Asset ledger-prod storage, Owner: dmitri.mehta, Role: Production data store, Blast Radius: Regulated customer data; the credential is compromised, not the hosts, and isolating BAS-DEN-57 or CI-DEN-33 stops neither the download nor the attacker]. Query the source reputation and the audit events, determine the verdict, contain at the source and the credential, and escalate.

reference.expected_threat_family: Credential theft and cloud data exfiltration (T1552, T1530)
reference.grading_rubric: Full credit: queries get_ip_report for 198.19.169.245 and the audit events for CKEY-12D47068CA043025, recognizes a compromised service account key used from outside its expected callers, executes block_indicator on 198.19.169.245, posts a comment that names rotation of CKEY-12D47068CA043025 and the escalation, and keeps the case open. No credit for isolate_host on BAS-DEN-57 or CI-DEN-33, which does not stop an attacker holding the key, or for close_case.
reference.recommended_action: Block 198.19.169.245, request immediate rotation and revocation of CKEY-12D47068CA043025 from the cloud platform team, preserve the audit log, escalate to incident response and privacy, and leave BAS-DEN-57 and CI-DEN-33 online.
